dialog.english:
That's... whoa, an iceberg!
We're gonna crash,
we're gonna craaaaaash!
dialog.translation:
¡Eso es... uah, un iceberg!
¡Vamos a chocar,
vamos a chocaaaaar!

dialog.english: Whoaaaaaaaaa!
Owwww. Agumon, are you okay?

Yeah. The snow cushioned me,
but...
dialog.translation:
Sí, la nieve lo ha amortiguado,
pero...

dialog.english:
I-it's coooold! We're gonna
freeze.

I've got an idea! Want me to warm
you up, Tai?
dialog.translation:
¡Tengo una idea! ¿Quieres que te dé
calor, Tai?

dialog.english:
Oh! You mean with your Baby Flame!
Okay, but be careful.
dialog.translation:
¡Ah! ¡Dices con tu Llama Bebé!
Vale, pero ten cuidado.

dialog.english: Got it! Baby Flame!
Hot, hot! Hoooooooot!
Agh, I overdid it! Sorry, Tai!

I wonder where we're headed...
I don't know about anything but
the island.
dialog.translation:
Me pregunto a dónde vamos...
No conozco nada que no sea la
isla.

dialog.english:
Devimon said something
about beyond the sea...
dialog.translation:
Devimon dijo algo acerca de
un continente...

dialog.english: Where did everyone go...?
Yuuuuukidaaaarumoooooooon!

It's Frigimon! He's being
controlled by a black gear!
Huh... Why was I rampaging?

We did it! We destroyed the black
gear!

You're not hurt, are you? I saw a
kid like you and a Gabumon fall
over there.
dialog.translation:
Estás bien, ¿verdad? Vi a un niño
como tú y un Gabumon caer por
aquí.

dialog.english: Is Matt on that island?!

But how are we gonna get there? I
can't swim...
dialog.translation:
¿Pero cómo llegaremos allí? No
puedo nadar...

dialog.english:
Well, as my way of thanking you,
I'll help you get there!
dialog.translation:
¡Bueno, como agradecimiento, te
ayudaré a llegar!

dialog.english: Can you do that?

Yeah. I'll freeze the sea to make
an ice bridge to the next island.
dialog.translation:
Claro. Congelaré el mar para
hacer un puente gélido hacia la
isla.

dialog.english:
I see! With a bridge, we can just
walk there!
So? Should we go?

It's not like we have anything
left to do here...
dialog.translation:
No es que tengamos nada mejor
que hacer...

dialog.english: Let's explore a bit more first.
All right! Let's go look for Matt!

Got it. I'll be waiting here, so
call me when you're ready.
dialog.translation:
Vale. Estaré esperando aquí,
avisa cuando estés preparado.

dialog.english: Thanks, Frigimon!
Okay! Let's go!
